disposition: Convergence is a contract-defined state (CONVERGENCE_DEFINITION in src/replication/mod.rs) reported with member names, operation identity, and observation time; one-Region and two-Region healthy-link cases, delayed and reordered delivery, duplicate delivery, and secret-free Replication Receipts are all focused-tested on the lanes. No bounded-lag or synchronous-replication claim is made, and deployed-Region qualification is P7.
